title.en: Your visual workspace in Microsoft Edge
title.zh-CN: 在 Microsoft Edge 中使用可视化书签工作空间

summary.en: Bring native favorites, search and a full Excalidraw canvas into Edge's new tab, with optional hands-on learning and your own AI provider. New help links and quieter embed loading messages keep common tasks close at hand.
summary.zh-CN: 将原生收藏夹、搜索与完整 Excalidraw 画布放进 Edge 新标签页，按需使用实操引导和自配 AI。新增帮助入口与更安静的嵌入加载提示，让常用操作更容易找到。

title.en: An Edge workspace for native favorites
title.zh-CN: 围绕 Edge 原生收藏夹的工作空间

description.en: Import selected favorites onto a full drawing canvas, switch icon/compact/detailed cards, add notes and open a site from its icon. Use the toolbar popup to save a webpage and choose whether to open the canvas afterward. Existing browser folders remain under your control.
description.zh-CN: 把选定收藏夹添加到完整绘图画布，切换图标／简洁／详细卡片、填写备注并点击图标打开网站。工具栏弹窗可收藏网页，并选择添加后是否打开画布；原生收藏夹结构仍由你管理。

where.en: Canvas → Import bookmarks; select cards; browser toolbar → Bookmark Atlas
where.zh-CN: 画布 → 导入书签；选中卡片；浏览器工具栏 → Bookmark Atlas

title.en: Find embedding help and request site support
title.zh-CN: 查看嵌入教程并申请网站适配

description.en: Settings now links to the web-embed guide, the GitHub project and the issue/site-adaptation form. Bilibili and YouTube have dedicated adaptations; other websites may still impose login, region or framing limits.
description.zh-CN: 设置新增网页嵌入教程、GitHub 项目和问题／网站适配入口。B站和 YouTube 有专门适配；其他网站仍可能限制登录、地区或嵌入。

where.en: Settings → Community and online help
where.zh-CN: 设置 → 社区与在线帮助

title.en: Browser-default search follows your interface language
title.zh-CN: 浏览器默认搜索名称跟随界面语言

description.en: The default search label is consistent in the switcher, engine manager, placeholder and suggestions, including old saved configurations. It uses the browser's default search API and preserves custom engine names and identifiers.
description.zh-CN: 切换器、引擎管理、占位提示和预搜索中统一显示当前语言的默认搜索名称，兼容旧配置；继续调用浏览器默认搜索接口，保留自定义引擎名称和身份。

where.en: Search bar; Settings → Manage search engines; Settings → Language
where.zh-CN: 搜索栏；设置 → 管理搜索引擎；设置 → 语言

title.en: Quiet help when a website takes longer
title.zh-CN: 网页加载较慢时提供安静帮助

description.en: After twenty seconds, a slow-loading embed shows a small status you can open for help. It keeps the page loading and never automatically refreshes, navigates, pauses media or blocks the canvas. A load event does not prove a restricted site is usable.
description.zh-CN: 嵌入加载二十秒后显示小型慢提示，可主动展开帮助；页面继续加载，不自动刷新、跳转、暂停播放或阻断画布。收到 load 信号不代表受限制网站一定能使用。

where.en: Web embed → loading status → help
where.zh-CN: 网页嵌入 → 加载状态 → 帮助

title.en: Keep embed sessions stable during ordinary canvas work
title.zh-CN: 普通画布操作中保持嵌入会话稳定

description.en: Avoid redundant URL work on parent renders and remove an intermediate iframe when changing a Bilibili video from full-page mode. Existing sandbox, activation and playback behavior are retained; third-party media/network performance still depends on the site and connection.
description.zh-CN: 减少父页面更新时的重复网址处理，避免 B站完整页模式修改视频网址时出现中间 iframe。保留原有沙箱、交互激活和播放行为；第三方媒体及网络表现仍取决于网站与连接。

where.en: Canvas with web embeds; editing a Bilibili video URL
where.zh-CN: 含网页嵌入的画布；修改 B站视频网址

title.en: Patched bundled content-processing libraries
title.zh-CN: 修补随扩展分发的内容处理库

description.en: Pin DOMPurify3.4.17 and lodash-es4.18.1 to compatible upstream security fixes before packaging. Keep the same Excalidraw version and browser permissions; this does not claim that all dependencies or all third-party websites are free of vulnerabilities.
description.zh-CN: 打包前将 DOMPurify 固定为3.4.17、lodash-es固定为4.18.1，采用兼容的上游安全修复；保留 Excalidraw 版本和浏览器权限，不宣称所有依赖或第三方网站不存在漏洞。

where.en: Automatic when bundled diagram and content processors are used
where.zh-CN: 使用打包的图表与内容处理能力时自动生效

gettingStarted.en: Choose Import bookmarks on the canvas, select a favorite or folder, then close the picker. Click its icon to open it, or select cards to change presentation, add notes and preview arrangements.
gettingStarted.zh-CN: 在画布点击「导入书签」，选择收藏夹或单个书签后关闭选择器。点击图标打开，或选中卡片切换展示、填写备注和预览排布。

gettingStarted.en: Use the toolbar icon to capture the current webpage. Open Settings → Learning guide for hands-on practice or the offline AI example; real AI requires your own configured service and explicit data consent.
gettingStarted.zh-CN: 通过工具栏图标收藏当前网页。「设置 → 使用指南」可实操练习或查看离线 AI 示例；真实 AI 需要自配服务并明确同意发送数据。

gettingStarted.en: Use More tools → Embed webpage, draw a region, enter an HTTPS URL and activate its center. Find provider details in Settings → Web embed guide.
gettingStarted.zh-CN: 点击「更多工具 → 嵌入网页」，拖出区域、填写 HTTPS 网址并激活中心；通过设置中的网页嵌入教程查看平台说明。

notices.en: Availability is determined by each store listing, separately from this package date. This edition does not add cross-browser synchronization. Eligible lightweight canvas data uses browser-managed sync; a local write is not a remote-device receipt and exact delivery time is not guaranteed. Images and binary attachments remain local.
notices.zh-CN: 是否可安装以各商店条目为准，与包日期分开记录。本版不增加跨浏览器同步；轻量画布数据使用浏览器管理的同步，本地写入不等于另一设备已收到，也不保证精确送达时间。图片和二进制附件仍在本机。

notices.en: AI is optional and may incur your provider's fees. Only approved selected card IDs, titles, site hostnames, canvas notes and your instruction enter the prompt; full URLs, folder paths and unrelated data are excluded. Config and encrypted credentials remain on this device, outside sync and backups; the local vault is not an OS keychain.
notices.zh-CN: AI 完全可选，可能产生服务商费用。提示仅含经确认的所选卡片 ID、标题、域名、画布备注和整理要求，不含完整网址、文件夹路径或无关数据。配置与密文凭据只在本机，不同步、不备份；本机凭据库不是系统钥匙串。

notices.en: Existing canvas and preferences are preserved, with no new mandatory permission or automatic data migration. The store extension and a separately loaded test extension have separate storage; export a full backup before choosing a manual transfer. Project-support payments remain disabled.
notices.zh-CN: 保留已有画布和偏好，不新增必需权限或自动迁移数据。商店扩展与单独侧载测试扩展的存储相互独立；如自行转移，请先导出完整备份。项目自愿支持仍关闭。

title.en: Learn on the real canvas, at your own pace
title.zh-CN: 在真实画布上，按自己的节奏学会使用

summary.en: Optional hands-on lessons now point to real controls, remember your place, and explain each step in English or Chinese. Every update also has its own complete introduction, so you can understand a release without repeating a course.
summary.zh-CN: 可选实操课程指向真实操作入口，记住学习位置，并用中英文解释每一步。每次更新也有独立完整的版本介绍，无需重学课程就能了解变化。

title.en: Optional lessons built around real actions
title.zh-CN: 围绕真实操作的可选课程

description.en: Choose hands-on basics, webpage capture, or optional AI organization. Practice adding, opening, moving, selecting, changing presentation, and reviewing layouts on the real canvas. Progress advances when the relevant action succeeds, rather than when you simply read the instructions.
description.zh-CN: 可选择基础体验、随手收藏网页或可选 AI 整理课程，在真实画布上练习添加、打开、移动、框选、切换展示形式及审阅排布。相关操作成功后才推进进度，仅阅读说明不会被算作完成。

where.en: Settings → Learning guide → choose a chapter
where.zh-CN: 设置 → 使用指南 → 选择章节

title.en: Pause, resume, and replay locally
title.zh-CN: 暂停、续学与本机重播

description.en: Pause a lesson and resume from the saved step, or replay a chapter whenever you need it. Learning progress stays in this browser profile; reopening the guide does not reset your bookmarks or require completed basics again after an ordinary update.
description.zh-CN: 暂停课程后可从保存的步骤继续，也可按需重播任意章节。学习进度只留在当前浏览器用户配置中；重开指南不重置书签，普通更新也不要求重学已完成的基础课程。

where.en: Learning guide → Pause; Settings → Learning guide → Resume learning or chapter replay
where.zh-CN: 使用指南 → 暂停；设置 → 使用指南 → 继续学习或重播章节

title.en: Try an offline AI demonstration first
title.zh-CN: 先看完全离线的 AI 效果演示

description.en: Inspect a local example of AI grouping before connecting a provider. The demonstration sends no request, requires no API key, and does not change your real canvas or count as completing real AI organization. Generating an actual preview still requires your chosen service and explicit consent.
description.zh-CN: 连接服务商前，可先查看本机示例的 AI 分组效果。演示不联网、不需要 API Key，不改真实画布，也不计为完成真实 AI 整理。生成实际预览仍需自配服务和明确同意。

where.en: Settings → Learning guide → AI organization (optional) → See the offline demo first
where.zh-CN: 设置 → 使用指南 → AI 整理（可选）→ 先看效果演示

title.en: A complete introduction for every update
title.zh-CN: 每次更新都有完整版本介绍

description.en: Read the version date, categorized changes, benefits, concrete entry points, starting steps, and notices in English or Chinese. Introductions stay available after the seven-day unread marker expires. A release check now requires a valid introduction for the package version, and an unknown version never borrows another release's content.
description.zh-CN: 用中英文查看版本日期、分类变化、用户收益、具体入口、上手步骤及注意事项。七天未读提示到期后，介绍仍可查看。发布检查要求当前包版本有合规介绍，未知版本也不会借用其他版本正文。

where.en: Settings → What is new → release introduction and full release notes
where.zh-CN: 设置 → 更新内容 → 版本介绍与完整发布说明

title.en: Precise guidance without blocking the canvas
title.zh-CN: 精准定位入口，不挡住画布操作

description.en: Hints highlight the specific button or field needed for the step and keep the canvas usable. Bilingual, collapsible instructions adapt to narrow windows, move clear of relevant tools, and offer recovery instructions if a selection or preview is no longer available.
description.zh-CN: 提示高亮当前步骤需要的具体按钮或输入框，画布仍可操作。可折叠的双语说明适配窄窗口，避让相关工具；选区或预览丢失时会说明如何恢复。

where.en: Active Learning guide → highlighted real control; expand or collapse the guide header
where.zh-CN: 进行中的使用指南 → 高亮的真实操作入口；指南标题栏展开或收起说明

title.en: Quiet small updates, explicit extra teaching
title.zh-CN: 小更新安静提示，大功能明确配置额外教学

description.en: This learning update uses quiet notes and a basics marker, without automatically restarting a lesson for returning users. Future releases can explicitly invite only a relevant feature chapter while keeping their full version introduction separately accessible.
description.zh-CN: 本次教学改进采用安静的版本说明和基础体验提示，不会自动要求老用户重新学习。后续版本可明确配置相关新功能章节邀请，同时保留独立完整的版本介绍入口。

where.en: Settings → What is new; Settings → Learning guide when you choose to learn
where.zh-CN: 设置 → 更新内容；希望学习时再打开「设置 → 使用指南」

title.en: Consistent learning state across open pages
title.zh-CN: 多个页面之间保持一致的学习状态

description.en: Coordinate the active guide across extension pages and persist learning actions locally. Reading release notes, using a highlighted feature, pausing a lesson, and completing a course remain separate, so one action does not falsely complete another.
description.zh-CN: 扩展页面之间协调当前展示的指南，并在本机保存学习操作。阅读版本介绍、使用带提示的功能、暂停课程与完成课程分别记录，避免一项操作被误算为另一项完成。

where.en: Open extension pages → Learning guide and Settings update markers
where.zh-CN: 已打开的扩展页面 → 使用指南及设置中的更新提示

gettingStarted.en: Open Settings → What is new to read this introduction. Returning users can continue using their existing canvas immediately; this update does not automatically restart a course.
gettingStarted.zh-CN: 打开「设置 → 更新内容」阅读介绍。老用户可直接继续使用已有画布，本次更新不会自动重启课程。

gettingStarted.en: Open Settings → Learning guide and choose Hands-on basics, Capture a webpage, or AI organization (optional). Follow the highlighted real control; expand or collapse the instructions when you need more canvas space.
gettingStarted.zh-CN: 打开「设置 → 使用指南」，选择基础体验、随手收藏网页或 AI 整理（可选）。跟随高亮的真实操作入口，需要更多画布空间时可展开或收起说明。

gettingStarted.en: Pause when you want to stop and use Resume learning to continue later. In the AI chapter, try the offline demo before deciding whether to configure a provider; only a real, approved AI preview and application complete that practical lesson.
gettingStarted.zh-CN: 需要离开时暂停，之后点击继续学习接着练习。AI 章节可先看离线演示，再决定是否配置服务商；真实 AI 实操仍需确认生成预览并应用才算完成。

notices.en: Existing bookmarks, canvas content, positions, notes, and saved settings are retained. No canvas reset, bookmark reimport, or new mandatory permission is required by this learning update.
notices.zh-CN: 保留已有书签、画布内容、位置、备注和已保存设置；本次教学更新无需重置画布、重新导入书签或授予新的必需权限。

notices.en: Learning progress is local to this browser profile and does not add cross-device synchronization. Images and binary attachments also remain local; native bookmark sync continues to follow your browser settings.
notices.zh-CN: 学习进度仅限当前浏览器用户配置，不新增跨设备同步。图片与二进制附件也仍只在本机；原生书签同步继续遵循浏览器设置。

notices.en: The offline AI demo is only a local example. Actual AI organization remains optional, requires your own compatible HTTPS provider, model, API key, and consent, and may incur provider charges. Saved configuration and credentials stay local and outside sync, sharing, and extension backups.
notices.zh-CN: 离线 AI 演示只是本机示例。实际 AI 整理仍为可选，需自配兼容 HTTPS 服务、模型、API Key 并明确同意，可能产生服务商费用；已保存配置与凭据只留本机，不参与同步、共享或扩展备份。

notices.en: The version date records the formal package freeze date, not Chrome Web Store approval or availability. Store submission, review, approval, and publication are tracked separately; this update does not change browser support or sync boundaries.
notices.zh-CN: 版本日期记录正式包冻结日期，不代表 Chrome 应用商店已通过审核或上架。提交、审核、批准和实际上架分别记录；本次更新不改变浏览器支持或同步边界。

title.en: Capture quickly, organize your way
title.zh-CN: 随手收藏，按自己的方式整理

summary.en: Save the page you are reading, choose how bookmarks appear, and optionally preview AI organization. A calmer workspace brings these tools together while preserving your existing canvas.
summary.zh-CN: 收藏正在阅读的网页，选择书签展示形式，按需预览 AI 整理。更清爽的工作区将这些操作收纳到一起，同时保留已有画布。

title.en: Capture now, organize later
title.zh-CN: 随手收藏，稍后整理

description.en: The extension popup saves the current HTTP/S page to native Other bookmarks / Bookmark Atlas and queues a canvas card locally. Repeated capture avoids duplicates; turn off Open canvas after adding to stay on your current page until you are ready to organize.
description.zh-CN: 扩展弹窗把当前 HTTP/S 网页保存到原生「其他书签 / Bookmark Atlas」，并可靠排队添加画布卡片，重复收藏避免重复项。取消「添加后打开画布」即可继续浏览，稍后再集中整理。

where.en: Browser toolbar → Bookmark Atlas extension icon → capture popup
where.zh-CN: 浏览器工具栏 → Bookmark Atlas 扩展图标 → 收藏弹窗

title.en: Three ways to display bookmarks
title.zh-CN: 三种书签展示形式

description.en: Switch selected cards between icon, compact, and detailed presentations to fit the amount of information you need. Each style has its own alignment; detailed cards show a shortened URL. Historical cards retain their detailed presentation, while new imports default to compact.
description.zh-CN: 将选中卡片切换为图标、简洁或详细形式，按需要展示信息。每种形式分别对齐，详细卡片显示缩略网址。历史卡片保留原详细形式，新导入默认简洁。

where.en: Select canvas bookmarks → presentation tools; Settings → default bookmark presentation
where.zh-CN: 选中画布书签 → 展示形式工具；设置 → 默认书签展示形式

title.en: Notes and layout previews
title.zh-CN: 画布备注与排布预览

description.en: Add canvas-only notes to selected bookmarks and preview an arrangement before applying it. This gives you space to explain a bookmark and inspect the proposed layout before changing the canvas.
description.zh-CN: 为选中的书签添加仅属于画布的备注，排布先预览再明确应用。既能留下收藏理由，也能先检查排布结果，再决定是否修改画布。

where.en: Select canvas bookmarks → notes and layout tools → preview → Apply
where.zh-CN: 选中画布书签 → 备注与排布工具 → 预览 → 应用

title.en: Optional AI organization with a preview
title.zh-CN: 可选 AI 整理，先预览再应用

description.en: Connect your own Chat Completions-compatible HTTPS service, approve the selected metadata, and review proposed groups, presentations, and notes. Apply an undoable change only after reviewing it; AI does not reorganize native Chrome bookmarks.
description.zh-CN: 连接自配、兼容 Chat Completions 的 HTTPS 服务，确认发送所选元数据后，检查建议分组、展示形式和备注。预览满意后再明确应用，可撤销；AI 不重排 Chrome 原生书签。

where.en: Select canvas bookmarks → AI organize → approve metadata → preview → Apply
where.zh-CN: 选中画布书签 → AI 整理 → 确认元数据 → 预览 → 应用

title.en: Reusable AI settings on this device
title.zh-CN: 可复用的本机 AI 设置

description.en: Explicitly save your endpoint, model, and API key for reuse on this device. Fetch a model list or enter a model manually, test the selected model separately, and clear the configuration when needed. A successful model list does not prove generation support; the fixed-prompt test may incur provider charges.
description.zh-CN: 明确保存接口、模型和 API Key，即可在本机复用。支持拉取模型或手动填写，独立测试所选模型，按需清除配置。模型列表成功不代表支持生成；固定提示的模型测试可能产生服务商费用。

where.en: Settings → AI settings → Save, model list, model test, or Clear
where.zh-CN: 设置 → AI 设置 → 保存、拉取模型、模型测试或清除配置

title.en: A quieter workspace
title.zh-CN: 更清爽的工作区

description.en: Settings and contextual canvas tools collect previously scattered actions. Excalidraw stays the default theme, and the search bar adapts to narrow screens so common actions remain easier to reach.
description.zh-CN: 设置与画布上下文工具收纳原先分散的操作，保持 Excalidraw 为默认主题，并让搜索栏适配窄屏，常用操作更容易找到。

where.en: Top toolbar → Settings; canvas selection and contextual menus
where.zh-CN: 顶部工具栏 → 设置；画布选中工具与上下文菜单

title.en: Open websites directly from bookmark icons
title.zh-CN: 单击书签图标，直接打开网页

description.en: Click a bookmark favicon to open its website in a new tab while keeping canvas selection, dragging, and keyboard navigation available. Embedded websites cannot replace the extension page.
description.zh-CN: 单击书签图标即可在新标签页打开网页，同时保留画布选择、拖动与键盘操作；网页嵌入不能覆盖插件页面。

where.en: Canvas bookmark card → favicon
where.zh-CN: 画布书签卡片 → 网站图标

title.en: Switch language without reloading
title.zh-CN: 无需刷新即可切换语言

description.en: Choose Follow browser, English, or Simplified Chinese in Settings and see the interface change in place. The canvas is not reset, and the preference stays local to this browser profile.
description.zh-CN: 在设置中选择跟随浏览器、English 或简体中文，界面即时切换，无需刷新或重置画布；偏好仅保存在当前浏览器用户配置中。

where.en: Settings → Language
where.zh-CN: 设置 → 语言

title.en: More reliable startup sync
title.zh-CN: 启动同步更稳定

description.en: Incoming canvas updates wait for local initialization before conflict classification. This prevents a false startup conflict prompt while retaining protection for real conflicting changes.
description.zh-CN: 传入画布更新会等本机初始化完成后才判定冲突，避免启动误报，同时保留真正修改冲突的保护。

where.en: Open the canvas with saved local content and an incoming sync update
where.zh-CN: 打开已有本机内容、同时收到同步更新的画布时自动生效

title.en: Encrypted local API-key storage
title.zh-CN: 本机 API Key 加密保存

description.en: Saved API keys use AES-GCM-256 encryption with fresh IVs and endpoint binding; the encryption key is generated locally in the extension's IndexedDB. Configuration and credentials stay out of sync, sharing, and extension backups. This is not an OS keychain or absolute protection from someone controlling the browser profile or runtime.
description.zh-CN: 已保存 API Key 使用 AES-GCM-256、每次全新 IV 和接口绑定加密；加密密钥在扩展专用 IndexedDB 中本机生成。配置与凭据不参与同步、共享或扩展备份。这不等同于系统钥匙串，也无法绝对防范控制浏览器用户配置或运行环境的人。

where.en: Settings → AI settings → explicitly Save; Clear removes saved configuration and credentials
where.zh-CN: 设置 → AI 设置 → 明确保存；清除配置会移除已保存配置与凭据

gettingStarted.en: Open a normal HTTP/S webpage, click the Bookmark Atlas extension icon, and capture it. Leave Open canvas after adding enabled to see the queued card immediately, or disable it and open the canvas later.
gettingStarted.zh-CN: 打开普通 HTTP/S 网页，点击 Bookmark Atlas 扩展图标并收藏。保持「添加后打开画布」可立即查看排队添加的卡片；也可取消，稍后再打开画布。

gettingStarted.en: Select bookmarks on the canvas, try icon, compact, or detailed presentation, add a note, and inspect a layout preview before applying it.
gettingStarted.zh-CN: 选中画布书签，试用图标、简洁或详细形式，添加备注，并在应用前检查排布预览。

gettingStarted.en: For optional AI organization, first save your own compatible endpoint, model, and key in Settings → AI settings. Then select bookmarks, open AI organize, approve the metadata, and review the preview before applying it.
gettingStarted.zh-CN: 如需 AI 整理，先在「设置 → AI 设置」保存自配兼容接口、模型和 Key，再选中书签，打开「AI 整理」，确认元数据并检查预览后应用。

notices.en: No canvas reset or bookmark reimport is required. Existing positions, frames, notes, and user content remain intact; historical cards without a presentation field keep their legacy detailed style.
notices.zh-CN: 无需清空画布或重新导入书签，保留已有位置、框架、备注和用户内容；没有展示字段的历史卡片继续使用旧版详细形式。

notices.en: AI is opt-in and requires your own provider, model, and API key. Provider fees and privacy policies apply; model tests can incur charges. Only approved selected metadata and your instruction are sent, not full URLs, folder paths, history, other tabs, images, or the rest of the canvas.
notices.zh-CN: AI 需主动启用并自配服务商、模型和 API Key；适用服务商费用与隐私政策，模型测试也可能收费。仅发送已确认的选中元数据及整理要求，不发送完整网址、文件夹路径、历史、其他标签页、图片或其余画布。

notices.en: Saved AI settings and credentials belong only to this installed extension and browser profile. Older session-only keys were not saved; enter and explicitly save a key once to reuse it. Configuration, credentials, and encryption keys are excluded from sync, sharing, and extension backups.
notices.zh-CN: 已保存 AI 配置与凭据仅属于本机当前安装的扩展及浏览器用户配置。旧版仅会话 Key 未保存，需重新输入并明确保存一次才能复用；配置、凭据与加密密钥均不参与同步、共享或扩展备份。

notices.en: Images and binary attachments remain local and do not sync across devices. Native bookmarks still follow the browser's bookmark-sync settings; captures queued without opening the canvas finish insertion after the canvas opens and saves successfully. This release does not add cross-browser sync or claim production Edge/Safari support.
notices.zh-CN: 图片和二进制附件仍只保留在本机，不跨设备同步。原生书签仍按浏览器自身书签同步设置管理；不打开画布的收藏在之后打开画布并成功保存后完成添加。本版不增加跨浏览器同步，也不宣称 Edge/Safari 已正式支持。
